title: ui.per_package 1.0
description: content::PackageUi (experimental, SWOFTY_BOX_UI=1): one box's own UI textures. While the box is the pressed one (Grand Prix or Time Trial; not careers in this release), the core routes each listed ui_package archive to its own copy in which every resource the archive shares with textures is swapped; leaving the box puts the game's archives back. A copy is read the next time the game loads that archive: race UI archives load with each session, front-end ones when the front end loads again. Archives the game loads at boot and keeps (persistent.erp, flow_persistent.erp, screens/persistent.erp, fonts*.erp) are refused, and a resource that one of them also holds stays stock, because the game keeps the first copy of a name it loads.

root.description: The resource name a folder's file paths are appended to.

srgb.description: A .png file is encoded as sRGB BC7 when true, linear BC7 when false. A .dds file keeps its own format.

archives.description: The ui_package archives to swap, as game paths (2025_asset_groups/ui_package/...erp).

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.

path.description: The textures: a folder in the addon's folder holding .dds and .png files (a file at osd/textures/message_system/ms_fia_logo.png is the resource root + osd/textures/message_system/ms_fia_logo.tif.image, with its .tif view), or { "erp", "resources" } for resources of an archive in the addon's folder, named like the stock resources they replace.
